items.quote: Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiffnecked people
items.claim: The LORD told Moses to inform the children of Israel that they are a stiffnecked people

items.quote: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee
items.claim: The LORD stated that he will come up in the midst of the children of Israel and consume them

items.quote: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee
items.claim: The LORD commanded the children of Israel to put off their ornaments
